question: In a certain code language, if ESTEEM is written as HVWHHP, then how will DOCTOR be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87175a202adbe402168cb2e56507356bca7605c33cdf304aed8291801291e4fd.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Positional value of letters of given word + 3.** 

ESTEEM is written as HVWHHP.
